overall_goal: Puree the soup with a hand blender, then prepare and stir in the spice mix and fresh coriander

goals.description: Assemble the hand blender and position the pot of soup
goals.rationale: The person unboxes, assembles, and plugs in the hand blender, then moves the hot pot of soup closer to prepare for blending.

goals.description: Puree the soup using the right hand
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly dips, turns on, and moves the hand blender through the soup to puree the carrots.

goals.description: Switch hands and continue pureeing the soup
goals.rationale: The person transfers the blender to the left hand to rest the right hand, continuing to blend until the soup is smooth.

goals.description: Measure and add spice mix to the soup
goals.rationale: The person opens the spice jar, measures the spice into the lid, and pours it into the pureed soup.

goals.description: Blend the spice mix into the soup
goals.rationale: The person uses the hand blender to stir and blend the newly added spice mix into the soup.

goals.description: Retrieve coriander, chopping board, and strainer
goals.rationale: The person gathers the necessary items, including the coriander, a chopping board, and a strainer from the cupboard, to prepare the fresh herbs.

goals.description: Place coriander in the strainer and wash it
goals.rationale: The person transfers handfuls of coriander into the strainer and rinses it under the tap to remove dirt.

goals.description: Separate the coriander leaves from the stems
goals.rationale: The person picks through the washed coriander, separating the leaves onto the chopping board and discarding the stems.

goals.description: Dry hands, retrieve a knife, and chop the coriander leaves
goals.rationale: The person dries their hands, gets a knife from the drawer, and coarsely chops the coriander leaves on the board.

goals.description: Blend the soup further and stir in the chopped coriander
goals.rationale: The person briefly blends the soup again, then slides the chopped coriander into the pot and stirs it in with a spatula.
